notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

How's everybody doing?
We'd like to share with you some of the fixes implemented on this latest build.


[list]
[*] English text has been corrected and improved
[*] Localization improvements
[*] Event related content is included for future use
[/list]



We hope that with these improvements, you will have the time to enjoy this story even more.

Get ready for more, we cant wait to share those details.

notes.title: First Discount!!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there guys!!!![/h1]
So, just letting you guys know, we are happy to announce our first ever....20% OFF discount sale!!

Definitely don't miss it!!
This game is a Visual Novel, where you can enjoy comedy, drama, mystery, and romance.
The total playtime is over 10 hours!!
Please, have fun!
